\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 199-202 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R207-first-pass-words-from-chapters-199-202}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a ladle and a sieve.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item rubbish, between, beyond, on this side, at the foot of
  \item for the sake of, instead, a problem, a solution, according to
  \item likewise, except, fortunately, unfortunately, somehow
  \item a motivation, insistence, a good quality, a drawback, fairness
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Rubbish? (\textbf{\ml{മാലിന്യം}}, \emph{mālinyaṁ}.) Between? (\textbf{\ml{ഇടയിൽ}}, \emph{iṭayil}.) Beyond? (\textbf{\ml{അപ്പുറം}}, \emph{appuṟaṁ}.) On this side? (\textbf{\ml{ഇപ്പുറം}}, \emph{ippuṟaṁ}.) At the foot of? (\textbf{\ml{ചുവട്ടിൽ}}, \emph{cuvaṭṭil}.) For the sake of? (\textbf{\ml{വേണ്ടി}}, \emph{vēṇṭi}.) Instead? (\textbf{\ml{പകരം}}, \emph{pakaraṁ}.) A problem? (\textbf{\ml{പ്രശ്നം}}, \emph{praśnaṁ}.) A solution? (\textbf{\ml{പരിഹാരം}}, \emph{parihāraṁ}.) According to? (\textbf{\ml{അനുസരിച്ച്}}, \emph{anusariccŭ}.) Likewise? (\textbf{\ml{അതുപോലെ}}, \emph{atupōle}.) Except? (\textbf{\ml{ഒഴികെ}}, \emph{oḻike}.) Fortunately? (\textbf{\ml{ഭാഗ്യവശാൽ}}, \emph{bhāgyavaśāl}.) Unfortunately? (\textbf{\ml{നിർഭാഗ്യവശാൽ}}, \emph{nirbhāgyavaśāl}.) Somehow? (\textbf{\ml{എങ്ങനെയെങ്കിലും}}, \emph{eṅṅaneyeṅkiluṁ}.) A motivation? (\textbf{\ml{പ്രേരണ}}, \emph{prēraṇa}.) Insistence? (\textbf{\ml{നിർബന്ധം}}, \emph{nirbandhaṁ}.) A good quality? (\textbf{\ml{ഗുണം}}, \emph{guṇaṁ}.) A drawback? (\textbf{\ml{ദോഷം}}, \emph{dōṣaṁ}.) Fairness? (\textbf{\ml{ന്യായം}}, \emph{nyāyaṁ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 203-207 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R207-second-pass-words-from-chapters-203-207}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for tasty and rotten.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item tasty, rotten, loose, tight, empty
  \item poor, dirty, smooth, rough, round
  \item simple, useful, excellent, strange, modern
  \item naughty, obedient, selfish, permanent, single
  \item the floor, a candle, a cooking pan, a ladle, a sieve
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Tasty? (\textbf{\ml{രുചിയുള്ള}}, \emph{ruciyuḷḷa}.) Rotten? (\textbf{\ml{ചീഞ്ഞ}}, \emph{cīñña}.) Loose? (\textbf{\ml{അയഞ്ഞ}}, \emph{ayañña}.) Tight? (\textbf{\ml{ഇറുകിയ}}, \emph{iṟukiya}.) Empty? (\textbf{\ml{കാലിയായ}}, \emph{kāliyāya}.) Poor? (\textbf{\ml{പാവം}}, \emph{pāvaṁ}.) Dirty? (\textbf{\ml{അഴുക്കുള്ള}}, \emph{aḻukkuḷḷa}.) Smooth? (\textbf{\ml{മിനുസമുള്ള}}, \emph{minusamuḷḷa}.) Rough? (\textbf{\ml{പരുക്കൻ}}, \emph{parukkan}.) Round? (\textbf{\ml{ഉരുണ്ട}}, \emph{uruṇṭa}.) Simple? (\textbf{\ml{ലളിതമായ}}, \emph{laḷitamāya}.) Useful? (\textbf{\ml{ഉപയോഗപ്രദമായ}}, \emph{upayōgapradamāya}.) Excellent? (\textbf{\ml{മികച്ച}}, \emph{mikacca}.) Strange? (\textbf{\ml{വിചിത്രമായ}}, \emph{vicitramāya}.) Modern? (\textbf{\ml{ആധുനിക}}, \emph{ādhunika}.) Naughty? (\textbf{\ml{കുസൃതിയുള്ള}}, \emph{kusṛtiyuḷḷa}.) Obedient? (\textbf{\ml{അനുസരണയുള്ള}}, \emph{anusaraṇayuḷḷa}.) Selfish? (\textbf{\ml{സ്വാർത്ഥമായ}}, \emph{svārtthamāya}.) Permanent? (\textbf{\ml{സ്ഥിരമായ}}, \emph{sthiramāya}.) Single? (\textbf{\ml{ഒറ്റ}}, \emph{oṟṟa}.) The floor? (\textbf{\ml{തറ}}, \emph{taṟa}.) A candle? (\textbf{\ml{മെഴുകുതിരി}}, \emph{meḻukutiri}.) A cooking pan? (\textbf{\ml{ചട്ടി}}, \emph{caṭṭi}.) A ladle? (\textbf{\ml{തവി}}, \emph{tavi}.) A sieve? (\textbf{\ml{അരിപ്പ}}, \emph{arippa}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
